select null as inv_id, inventory.sku_id, inventory.warehouse_id, sum(inventory.quantity) as quantity, sum(ifnull(inventory.locked_quantity, 0)) as locked_quantity, (sum(inventory.quantity) - sum(ifnull(inventory.locked_quantity, 0))) as available_quantity, null as stock_code, sum(ifnull(inventory.move_count, 0)) as move_count, sku.sku_name, sku.barcode, sku.length, sku.width, sku.height, sku.volume, sku.net_weight, item.id as item_id, item.item_code, item.item_name, item.item_image, item.item_model, item.safety_stock, category.category_name, merchant.merchant_name as supplier_name, warehouse.warehouse_name from wms_inventory inventory inner join wms_item_sku sku on inventory.sku_id=sku.id inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id left join wms_item_category category on category.id = item.item_category left join wms_merchant merchant on merchant.id = item.supplier_id left join wms_warehouse warehouse on warehouse.id = inventory.warehouse_id
item.safety_stock is not null and item.safety_stock > 0
and inventory.warehouse_id = #{bo.warehouseId}
and item.item_code like concat('%', #{bo.itemCode}, '%')
and item.item_name like concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
group by inventory.warehouse_id, inventory.sku_id having sum(inventory.quantity) < max(item.safety_stock) order by item.item_code, warehouse.warehouse_name
